name: ColNeRF
aliases: Collaboration for Generalizable Sparse Input Neural Radiance Field
definition: A generalizable sparse input neural radiance field that uses collaboration between sparse input images and output constraints to align information from various views and ensure multi-view consistency in geometry and appearance without auxiliary supervision.
summary: ColNeRF is a generalizable sparse-input neural radiance field method that uses Collaborative Cross-View Volume Integration and self-supervised ray regularization for accurate 3D modeling.
